intent: The family's shared shortlist. Saved is a tab (venues, services, packages) with live availability on the Brief date; Compare is a quiet tray plus a pushed three-column table that fits 390px without horizontal scroll. Both live on the account (ADR 0038: no guest mode); a mother who opens a shared link signs in first (ADR 0009). Compare is never a tab and never nags.

screens.purpose: Wishlist tab with three segments (Venues, Services, Packages), live availability and price-drop badges against the Brief date, multi-select into Compare, and honest local-only behaviour for guests.
interactions: Segmented control Venues | Services | Packages; each segment lists compact rows (72 x 88 thumbnail, name, area, price line, availability line) sorted with available halls first
Heart on a row removes it with an Undo snackbar; no swipe actions (every action has a visible control)
'Select' enters multi-select with a 'Compare (n/3)' bar; the fourth selection is blocked with the Replace sheet (CL-SAVD-03); 'Compare' opens the table (CL-SAVD-04)
Availability lines refresh against the Brief: 'Still free on Thu 14 Jan', 'On hold', 'Booked on Thu 14 Jan'; a price-drop badge appears when price or an offer changed for the Brief date
A row whose venue left the platform shows 'No longer listed' with a Remove action; rows open Venue detail, vendor profile or the planner packages

Rows show the voucher price as the price line with "Standard KD X" beneath; a "Voucher ready" tag appears when the client holds a ready voucher for that venue (opens CL-VCHR-03); the old offer-driven "Price dropped" badge is replaced by "Saving changed" when the voucher saving for the Brief date changed
screens.contentNotes: Venues segment for the demo persona: 1) فندق أوريليا الخليج / Aurelia Gulf Hotel, 'Still free on Thu 14 Jan', 'KD 18,200 for 350 guests'; 2) فندق لومي مارينا / Lumi Marina Hotel, free, KD 13,300; 3) قصر جوهرة السالمية للأفراح / Jawharat Al-Salmiya Palace, 'On hold'; 4) قصر النخيل للأفراح / Qasr Al-Nakheel, badge 'Price dropped' with 'KD 10,850 for 350 guests' and the previous price struck through (KD 11,900, a real price from the last 28 days); 5) مركز وصل للمؤتمرات والأفراح / Wasl Convention and Wedding Centre, Instant booking badge. Services segment: «استوديو لمحة للتصوير» / Lamha Photography Studio 'From KD 450', «زهور النخيل» / Nakheel Blooms 'From KD 900'. Packages segment mixes venue packages («الحفل النسائي · نهاية الأسبوع») and the planner tier «الذهبية». Empty states are warm and short, for example «لم تحفظوا أي قاعة بعد. اضغطوا على القلب في أي بطاقة لحفظها هنا.» / 'Nothing saved yet. Tap the heart on any hall to keep it here.' A 'Your shortlist' module on Home mirrors the first three saved halls. Sign-up nudge appears once after the third heart. Tab bar visible; the Compare tray sits above it.

screens.purpose: The anti-nag Compare tray: one component with five states that appears only after the first add and only on Home, Results and Saved. On Venue detail it becomes a header badge so it never covers the sticky price bar.
interactions: Appears after the first add, above the tab bar, with three 40 x 40 slots; with one venue it reads 'Add one more to compare' and empty slots are hairline boxes (neutral, not actionable)
With two or three venues it reads 'Compare (2)' and is actionable: tapping opens the table (CL-SAVD-04)
Collapses to a 44px pill after 3 seconds idle and on scroll-down; returns on scroll-up; never re-prompts after 'Clear' in the same session
Remove a venue with the small x on its slot (44px target); a fourth add opens the Replace sheet (CL-SAVD-03)
Rises over 320 ms; the new thumbnail fades and scales from 0.9 over 200 ms with a light haptic; reduced motion cross-fades
Never shown inside booking, My Wedding, Messages or Profile; never triggers a push; the set belongs to the account
screens.contentNotes: Slots for the demo: Aurelia Gulf Hotel, Lumi Marina Hotel, Jawharat Al-Salmiya Palace. Copy: «إضافة قاعة أخرى للمقارنة» / 'Add one more to compare' and «مقارنة (2)» / 'Compare (2)'. The first venue added sits at inline-start (right in Arabic). Header badge on Venue detail shows only the count. CA-CMP-03 deviation recorded in ADR 0009: reachable from Saved at any time and from the tray or badge on every discovery surface rather than literally from anywhere.

screens.purpose: Shown on the fourth add: Compare holds three venues, so nothing is dropped silently and the user chooses which one to replace.
interactions: Three rows (thumbnail, name, area, price for the Brief) each act as a radio; tapping one replaces it with the new venue and closes the sheet
Cancel keeps the set unchanged and leaves the new venue unsaved to Compare
Opened from the card toggle, the Venue detail header, Results and Saved multi-select
screens.contentNotes: Title «أي قاعة تستبدلون؟» / 'Replace which one?'. Body: 'You can compare up to three halls. Choose one to swap for Qasr Al-Nakheel.' / «يمكن مقارنة 3 قاعات كحد أقصى. اختيار قاعة لاستبدالها بقصر النخيل للأفراح.» Rows: Aurelia Gulf Hotel 'KD 18,200 for 350 guests', Lumi Marina Hotel 'KD 13,300 for 350 guests', Jawharat Al-Salmiya Palace 'KD 11,550 for 350 guests' (the Brief has a date and guests, so no 'From': ADR 0004 D6). Selection is an ink border plus check, never gold alone.

screens.purpose: The three-venue comparison on a 390px screen: full-bleed fluid thirds, label above values, differences only by default, best-in-row markers on objective rows, and a footer of three channel-aware actions aligned to the columns. Booking can start from here with date and guests carried over.
interactions: Sticky header: 106 x 132 thumbnails with a remove control (24px icon in a 44px target), two-line names and area; collapses on scroll to 56px with 40px thumbnails
Row groups in order: Your date, Price, Capacity and layout, Facilities, Rating, Distance, Packages (expandable), Photos (three 106 x 80 strips that open the gallery)

'Differences only' segmented control, default on, with '7 matching rows hidden'; best-in-row dot (gold-ink) only on price (lowest for the Brief), distance (nearest), rating (highest with at least 5 reviews) and capacity 'best fit' (closest to your guests while at least your guests); never on subjective rows, never green or red
No date: the top group shows an inline 'Set your date' that opens the Brief sheet (CL-DISC-02) and price rows fall back to labelled 'From' prices

Share in the app bar opens the OS share sheet with the universal link /compare?ids=a,b,c and a generated preview image; a family member who is not signed in opens the app to sign in first, then lands on the same comparison (flagged OQ-B-12)
Price group has three rows: "Voucher price", "Standard price" and "You save" (best-in-row dot on the lowest voucher price); no deposit row

Footer: three 48px outline buttons aligned to the columns, labelled by state: "Get voucher" (voucher-eligible, date free), "See dates" (unavailable on the Brief date), "Official" (governmental facility); there is no "Request" or "Book" button
screens.contentNotes: Columns: Aurelia Gulf Hotel | Lumi Marina Hotel | Jawharat Al-Salmiya Palace, widths 130 / 120 / 143 at 390 / 360 / 430 with 12px inner padding. Cell budget: 14 characters in English, 12 in Arabic; longer content sits behind expandable rows; mandatory QA at 360px in Arabic. Demo values for Thu 14 Jan, 350 guests: Availability 'Free' / 'Free' / 'On hold'; Price for your date 'KD 18,200' / 'KD 13,300' / 'KD 11,550' (best dot on the lowest); Deposit 'KD 5,460' / 'KD 3,990' / 'KD 3,465'; From per guest 'KD 46 / guest' / 'KD 34 / guest' / 'KD 29 / guest'; Max guests '650' / '500' (best fit for 350) / '700'; Valet 'Included' / 'Extra' / 'Not offered'; Photography 'Female only' / 'Allowed' / 'Female only'; Rating '4.8 (212)' / '4.5 (138)' / '4.6 (224)'; Distance from Salmiya '18 min' / '4 min' (nearest) / '6 min'; Packages '3 · from KD 46' / '2 · from KD 34' / '2 · from KD 29'. Origin of distance is the device location when granted, otherwise the preferred governorates. A venue that became unavailable shows 'Booked' in its cell while the header stays; one that left the platform shows 'No longer listed' with Remove; a government hall column shows a dash in booking-only rows and 'Official channel' above its footer button. Instant halls read 'Book', never 'Book now'. Lowest-package pricing labelled 'Est.' until a package is chosen. Tab bar hidden. The same data-driven column component renders the planner tiers (CL-PLAN-01). Voucher model (ADR 0033): demo values for Thu 14 Jan, 350 guests (illustrative seed): voucher price KD 15,400 / KD 11,350 / on hold; standard KD 18,200 / KD 13,300 / KD 11,550; the "Deposit" row of the notes above is removed.
